items.question: How long does implementation typically take?
items.answer: Implementation timelines vary by project scope. Most integrations are completed in 8-12 weeks, with phased rollouts for larger organizations. We work closely with your team to minimize disruption.

items.question: Where is our data stored?
items.answer: All data stays in Vietnam, on servers inside the hospital (on-premise). Patient data never leaves the hospital's own infrastructure.

items.question: Can Aurion integrate with our existing systems?
items.answer: Yes. Aurion already connects to the hospital HIS for our clinical data repository project. For LIS, PACS or electronic medical records, we assess the systems early on and build connectors to fit the hospital's needs.

items.question: What kind of support do you provide?
items.answer: We provide dedicated launch support, scheduled check-ins, and rapid responses during business hours, with on-call escalation for critical issues.

items.question: How do you keep data secure?
items.answer: Aurion runs on-premise at the hospital, with encryption, role-based access and a full access log. Data is de-identified before it is used for research.

items.question: How does Aurion support digital transformation?
items.answer: Aurion helps hospitals digitise in line with the healthcare sector's digital transformation roadmap: bringing data into one place, automating paperwork and giving care teams their time back.
